purpose: Experimental initial cohort layout superseded before Phase 1 review because its 168 files exceeded the fixed crawl-001 file budget when combined with the existing corpus.

content.format: one supported key=value assignment per line
content.safety: The generator does not use or emit live credentials, local collected values, filesystem paths, per-record IDs, or scanner predictions.

evaluation.artifact_family_role: The experimental generated-cohort-XX directories were corpus-derived evaluation-only template proxies under split-002, never scan-time features.
evaluation.duplicate_expectation: Generated candidate values are unique and intentionally diverse; duplicate-001 remains the authoritative post-generation review.
